why: A call that cleared nothing has no price. Read as zero, a call that found no cross looks like one that traded at 0.00, and an analysis of clearing prices is dragged to the floor by every quiet call.

source.constructed: fm-server's MarketCall record as GET /marketplaces/{id}/calls answers each call: a manual call that found no cross, calledDate zone-less in UTC with milliseconds, as the server writes it.
